_comment: Editable corpus for Lore's daily horoscope. Read by DailyInterpreter. Planet and point names must match the app's display names (Sun … Pluto, North Node, Chiron, Lilith, Ascendant, Midheaven). Edit any line to change the reading; a missing or empty line falls back to the building blocks below.
_transits_comment: Bespoke transit lines keyed 'Mover|Tone|Target'. Tone is Conjunction, Flow (sextile or trine) or Tension (square or opposition). Mover is the planet moving today; Target is the point in the birth chart it touches. Written in the second person, as tendencies rather than predictions.

transits.Sun|Conjunction|Sun: Your solar return — the Sun comes back to where it was when you were born, the start of your personal year. Take stock of the year behind you and set one clear intention for the one ahead.
transits.Sun|Flow|Sun: You feel more like yourself than usual, and your energy and confidence are easy to draw on. A good day to act on something that matters to you personally.
transits.Sun|Tension|Sun: Outside demands may pull against what you want for yourself, and your energy can feel spent on other people's priorities. Notice where you are bending too far, and protect some time that is yours.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Moon: Head and heart line up today: what you want and what you need point the same way. Feelings are visible, so it is a good day for honest self-care and for doing what genuinely nourishes you.
transits.Sun|Flow|Moon: Inner and outer life cooperate, and you feel settled enough to get on with things. Family and home matters go smoothly; it is a pleasant day to look after the people close to you.
transits.Sun|Tension|Moon: What the day asks of you may not match what you feel like doing, which can leave you restless or touchy. Honour your needs where you can rather than overriding them.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Mercury: Your mind is lit up and your words carry weight. Speak up, write, pitch the idea, or make the call you have been putting off — people are listening.
transits.Sun|Flow|Mercury: Clear thinking and easy communication: a good day for planning, paperwork, learning or a conversation that needs to go well.
transits.Sun|Tension|Mercury: You may feel strongly about your opinions and be quick to argue them. Check facts before you commit, and listen as carefully as you speak.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Venus: Warmth and charm come easily, and you are more inclined to enjoy yourself. A lovely day for affection, beauty, socialising or a small indulgence.
transits.Sun|Flow|Venus: Relations with others are easy and pleasant. A good day to smooth things over, show appreciation, or spend time on something that delights you.
transits.Sun|Tension|Venus: A wish for ease and pleasure may clash with what the day requires, or you may want more appreciation than you are getting. Treat yourself kindly, but watch overspending.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Mars: Your energy and drive surge. Use it on something physical or a task that needs courage — just keep an eye on impatience and a short fuse.
transits.Sun|Flow|Mars: Energy and confidence are both on tap, so you can get a lot done. A strong day for exercise, initiative and tackling something you have been avoiding.
transits.Sun|Tension|Mars: Frustration builds quickly and ego clashes are more likely. Put the restless energy into physical effort rather than an argument, and go carefully around hazards.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Jupiter: Optimism and generosity are high and luck seems to lean your way. Think big, but keep promises realistic — enthusiasm makes it easy to overcommit.
transits.Sun|Flow|Jupiter: Things open up easily. A good day to ask for help, make plans for growth, learn something, or simply enjoy a sense of possibility.
transits.Sun|Tension|Jupiter: Big ideas and big appetites can run ahead of reality. Enjoy the confidence, but avoid overdoing it — in spending, eating, or promising more than you can deliver.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Saturn: A sober, responsible day. You may feel the weight of duties or be measured against expectations; steady, serious effort pays off better than shortcuts.
transits.Sun|Flow|Saturn: Discipline comes naturally. A productive day for practical work, long-range planning, or earning the trust of someone in authority.
transits.Sun|Tension|Saturn: Obstacles, delays or criticism may test your confidence. Don't take it as a verdict — do what is required, conserve energy, and keep going.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Uranus: Restless and wanting change, you may surprise others — or yourself. Welcome the unexpected, but avoid breaking something just to feel free.
transits.Sun|Flow|Uranus: A refreshing, inventive day. Try a new approach, follow a hunch, or do something just a little out of your routine.
transits.Sun|Tension|Uranus: Impatience with restrictions runs high and plans may be disrupted. Stay flexible, avoid rash moves, and leave some slack in your schedule.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Neptune: Sensitive and imaginative, you pick up on moods easily but may lack energy or clarity. Good for art, music and compassion; less good for hard decisions.
transits.Sun|Flow|Neptune: Intuition and imagination are strong. Make room for creative or spiritual pursuits, and trust a quiet sense of what feels right.
transits.Sun|Tension|Neptune: Things may be unclear and your energy low; it is easy to be misled or to mislead yourself. Double-check facts and don't sign anything important on a hunch.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Pluto: Intense feelings and a strong will rise up. Power dynamics are noticeable, so use the intensity to get to the root of something rather than to control it.
transits.Sun|Flow|Pluto: You can focus deeply and make real progress on something important. A good day for research, decisive change, or quietly asserting yourself.
transits.Sun|Tension|Pluto: Power struggles or pressure from others may surface. Avoid forcing outcomes; ask what you are really trying to control, and let go where you can.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|North Node: Today puts you in step with where your life wants to go. Pay attention to opportunities and people that seem to arrive on cue.
transits.Sun|Flow|North Node: Small choices today support your longer-term direction. Say yes to what helps you grow rather than what is merely comfortable.
transits.Sun|Tension|North Node: You may feel pulled between old habits and the direction you know is right for you. Notice the tug, and lean slightly toward growth.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Chiron: An old sore point may be touched today. Treat it with kindness — this is a chance to understand it better, and perhaps to help someone else with the same hurt.
transits.Sun|Flow|Chiron: A good day for healing conversations, therapy, or offering what you have learned the hard way to someone who needs it.
transits.Sun|Tension|Chiron: You may feel more vulnerable or self-critical than usual. Don't push through the ache; acknowledge it, and be gentle with yourself and others.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Lilith: Your untamed side wants daylight. Speak your truth and refuse what diminishes you — but choose the moment, as defiance draws attention today.
transits.Sun|Flow|Lilith: You can express independence and desire without apology or drama. Trust your instincts and set a boundary you have been hesitant about.
transits.Sun|Tension|Lilith: Feeling judged or constrained may provoke resentment or rebellion. Ask what you actually want before reacting, and take your desires seriously.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Ascendant: All eyes are on you. Your presence is strong and first impressions count — a good day to put yourself forward, start something new, or refresh your look.
transits.Sun|Flow|Ascendant: You come across well and feel at ease in your skin. Good for meeting people, interviews, or simply being more visible.
transits.Sun|Tension|Ascendant: You may feel exposed or at odds with how others see you, and other people's agendas loom large. Stay true to yourself without forcing it.
transits.Sun|Conjunction|Midheaven: Your work and public role are in the spotlight. Recognition is possible, so put your best effort where people in charge can see it.
transits.Sun|Flow|Midheaven: Career matters go smoothly and your efforts are noticed. A good day to advance goals or talk to someone with influence.
transits.Sun|Tension|Midheaven: Work and home or personal life may compete for your time. Balance them deliberately, and don't let professional pressure shake your confidence.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Sun: For a few hours your feelings and your sense of purpose line up. Check in with yourself and set one aim for the month that genuinely matters to you.
transits.Moon|Flow|Sun: A comfortable, balanced spell when you feel at ease with yourself. Good for easy cooperation at home and at work.
transits.Moon|Tension|Sun: A passing inner tug-of-war between what you want and what you need. Don't take a brief mood as a final judgement; let it settle before you decide.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Moon: Your monthly lunar return: emotional needs come to the fore and you feel things more acutely. Spend a little time on whatever makes you feel safe and cared for.
transits.Moon|Flow|Moon: You feel emotionally in tune with your surroundings for a while. A cosy, nurturing spell — good for family, food and comfort.
transits.Moon|Tension|Moon: Your mood may feel at odds with the day around you. Be patient with yourself and with others — it passes quickly.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Mercury: Feelings and thoughts merge, so you talk about what you feel and think with your heart. Good for heartfelt conversations; less good for cold logic.
transits.Moon|Flow|Mercury: You can put feelings into words with ease. A good few hours for writing, chatting, or sorting out a misunderstanding.
transits.Moon|Tension|Mercury: Emotions may cloud your thinking, or a remark may land the wrong way. Pause before you reply to anything that stings.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Venus: A soft, affectionate mood. Enjoy pleasant company, beauty or a treat — you are easy to please and pleasant to be around.
transits.Moon|Flow|Venus: A warm, sociable spell; harmony comes easily. Good for showing affection, making peace, or simply enjoying yourself.
transits.Moon|Tension|Venus: A craving for comfort or reassurance may run high. Indulge a little, but watch emotional spending or a wish to please at your own expense.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Mars: Feelings turn hot and quick: irritation, passion or urgency. Channel the energy into something active rather than snapping at someone.
transits.Moon|Flow|Mars: Emotional energy fuels action. A good few hours to tackle a task, exercise, or stand up for yourself with confidence.
transits.Moon|Tension|Mars: A short fuse for a few hours. Small provocations feel bigger than they are; count to ten and burn the energy off physically.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Jupiter: A buoyant, generous mood. You feel hopeful and expansive — enjoy it, but don't promise or eat more than you mean to.
transits.Moon|Flow|Jupiter: Optimism and goodwill flow. A lovely spell for kindness, encouragement and seeing the bright side.
transits.Moon|Tension|Jupiter: Feelings may be exaggerated or appetites outsize. Enjoy the warmth, but keep a sense of proportion.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Saturn: A serious, perhaps lonely mood: duties feel heavy for a while. Do one responsible thing and let yourself rest afterwards.
transits.Moon|Flow|Saturn: Calm and steady, you can handle practical matters without fuss. Good for routines, planning and dependable support.
transits.Moon|Tension|Saturn: You may feel unsupported or weighed down for a few hours. It is a mood, not the whole truth — lighten the load where you can.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Uranus: Restless and unpredictable feelings: you want a change of scene or a break from routine. Expect the unexpected and stay flexible.
transits.Moon|Flow|Uranus: A lively, open-minded spell. Do something spontaneous, meet someone new, or try a different way of doing a familiar thing.
transits.Moon|Tension|Uranus: Jittery and impatient, you may react abruptly to small changes. Build in some slack and avoid impulsive decisions.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Neptune: Dreamy and sensitive, you absorb the moods around you. Lovely for music, art or rest; vague for detailed work.
transits.Moon|Flow|Neptune: Intuition and compassion run high. A good spell for creative work, meditation, or quietly helping someone.
transits.Moon|Tension|Neptune: Feelings may be foggy and easily swayed. Avoid escapism and don't take on other people's moods as your own.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Pluto: Feelings run deep and strong for a few hours. Something buried may surface; let it, and look at it honestly without acting on it straight away.
transits.Moon|Flow|Pluto: Emotional insight comes easily. A good spell to get to the heart of a matter or to let go of something that no longer serves you.
transits.Moon|Tension|Pluto: Intense or possessive feelings may flare. Notice the urge to control or to dig in, and give it time to pass.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|North Node: A passing feeling nudges you toward the person you are becoming. Notice what — or who — feels emotionally right today.
transits.Moon|Flow|North Node: Feelings support your growth for a while. Follow the emotional pull that leads forward rather than back.
transits.Moon|Tension|North Node: Comfortable old habits tug at you for a few hours. Indulge them consciously, then return to what helps you grow.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Chiron: An old hurt may brush the surface for a few hours. Be gentle with yourself; feeling it is part of healing it.
transits.Moon|Flow|Chiron: A tender, healing spell. Comfort offered or received now goes a long way.
transits.Moon|Tension|Chiron: You may feel touchy or insecure for a while. Don't take offence too quickly; look after the sore spot instead.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Lilith: Raw feelings and private desires stir. Don't suppress them — notice what they are telling you about your needs.
transits.Moon|Flow|Lilith: You feel free to be yourself without apology for a while. Trust a gut instinct about what you want.
transits.Moon|Tension|Lilith: A flash of resentment or a sense of being judged may surface. Don't act out; ask what need is going unmet.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Ascendant: Your feelings show on your face for a few hours, and you are more sensitive to your surroundings. Be where you feel comfortable.
transits.Moon|Flow|Ascendant: You come across as warm and approachable. A good spell for meeting people and making a friendly impression.
transits.Moon|Tension|Ascendant: Your mood may clash with the image you want to present. Allow yourself to be less polished for a while.
transits.Moon|Conjunction|Midheaven: Your feelings are visible at work or in public, and you care how you are seen. Bring warmth to your role.
transits.Moon|Flow|Midheaven: Home and career sit comfortably together for a few hours. A good spell for a caring word with a colleague or boss.
transits.Moon|Tension|Midheaven: Work and home may compete for your feelings. Do what is needed, then give yourself time off.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Sun: Your mind is sharp and focused on your own goals. A good day to speak up for yourself, make plans, or get your ideas across.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Sun: Ideas come easily and you express yourself well. Good for learning, writing and getting things organised.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Sun: Opinions — yours and others' — may clash. Make your point without making it personal, and check details before acting.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Moon: Thoughts turn to feelings, family and home. A good day for heart-to-heart conversations or sorting out domestic logistics.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Moon: Head and heart talk to each other. Express what you feel clearly, and listen with sympathy.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Moon: Logic and emotion pull apart; a careless word may hurt, or you may overthink a feeling. Slow down in sensitive conversations.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Mercury: Your mental cycle renews: a burst of ideas, messages and plans. Good for starting a course of study or fresh thinking on an old problem.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Mercury: Your thinking is clear and your timing good. A productive day for communication, travel arrangements and paperwork.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Mercury: Crossed wires and scattered thoughts are likely. Double-check messages and don't try to juggle too much at once.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Venus: Kind words and good taste come naturally. Good for compliments, creative writing, negotiation, or a pleasant social exchange.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Venus: Diplomacy and charm smooth your communications. A good day to smooth over a disagreement or say something appreciative.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Venus: It may be tempting to say what people want to hear, or to overthink a relationship. Be tactful but honest.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Mars: Your mind is quick and your tongue sharp. Great for decisive thinking and debate — just avoid saying something you'll regret.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Mars: Mental energy is high and you can cut through problems quickly. Good for tackling a backlog or arguing a case.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Mars: Irritable exchanges and hasty decisions are likely. Pause before replying, and drive carefully.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Jupiter: Big ideas and broad thinking. Good for planning, publishing, teaching or learning — but don't skip the small print.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Jupiter: Optimistic, expansive thinking. A good day for good news, opportunities through conversation, or a stimulating exchange of ideas.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Jupiter: You may overpromise or overlook details in your enthusiasm. Think big, then check your facts.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Saturn: Serious, careful thinking. Good for concentration, contracts and structured work; less good for small talk.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Saturn: Practical, organised thinking. Excellent for detailed work, planning, or a serious conversation that needs to go well.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Saturn: Doubts, delays or criticism may weigh on your thinking. Be patient with slow progress, and avoid negative self-talk.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Uranus: Flashes of insight and unusual ideas. Write down the brainstorm — some of it is brilliant — but expect surprises in your schedule.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Uranus: Original thinking and lively conversation. A good day to try a new technology, method or angle on a problem.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Uranus: Restless, scattered thoughts and sudden changes of plan. Stay flexible, and avoid blurting things out.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Neptune: Imagination is rich but focus is soft. Great for creative writing or music; double-check facts and figures.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Neptune: Intuitive, poetic thinking. A good day for creative projects, empathic listening, or reading between the lines.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Neptune: Confusion, vagueness or misinformation is likely. Clarify instructions and don't sign anything you haven't fully understood.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Pluto: Probing, penetrating thought. Good for research, investigation or getting to the bottom of something — less so for light chat.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Pluto: Your words carry depth and persuasion. A good day for serious discussions, research or a transformative insight.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Pluto: Conversations may turn into power struggles or obsessive thinking. Say what you mean, but don't push to win at all costs.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|North Node: Ideas and conversations point you toward your future direction. Listen for advice that rings true.
transits.Mercury|Flow|North Node: Learning and communicating support your growth. Reach out or study something that moves you forward.
transits.Mercury|Tension|North Node: Old ways of thinking may hold you back. Notice repetitive thoughts and try a fresh perspective.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Chiron: Talking about a sensitive subject could be healing. Choose your words with care — yours and others' may land harder than intended.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Chiron: A good day for healing conversations, therapy, or sharing what you have learned from experience.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Chiron: Words may touch a raw nerve. Speak gently and avoid jumping to conclusions about what others meant.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Lilith: Unspoken truths want voicing. Say what you really think, but consider your audience.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Lilith: You can express unconventional views confidently. A good day for frank conversations on taboo subjects.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Lilith: You may feel silenced, or be tempted to provoke. Find a constructive outlet for what you need to say.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Ascendant: You are talkative and alert, and your words shape how others see you. Good for interviews, introductions and putting yourself across.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Ascendant: Communication flows easily. A good day to network, make calls, or present your ideas.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Ascendant: Misunderstandings in how you come across are possible. Clarify your intentions, and listen to feedback.
transits.Mercury|Conjunction|Midheaven: Work communications are prominent. Good for presentations, important emails, or discussing career plans.
transits.Mercury|Flow|Midheaven: Your ideas are well received at work. A good day to pitch, plan or network professionally.
transits.Mercury|Tension|Midheaven: Work talk may be stressful or conflict with home life. Prioritise clearly and keep communications precise.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Sun: You shine socially and feel good about yourself. A day for pleasure, affection and being appreciated — treat yourself, and others, well.
transits.Venus|Flow|Sun: Charm and goodwill come easily. A pleasant day for socialising, romance or creative enjoyment.
transits.Venus|Tension|Sun: You may want more attention or comfort than is on offer, or feel a little lazy. Enjoy yourself without overindulging.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Moon: Tender, affectionate feelings. A lovely day for closeness with loved ones, making home beautiful, and being kind to yourself.
transits.Venus|Flow|Moon: Emotional warmth and harmony. Good for family time, comfort and showing people you care.
transits.Venus|Tension|Moon: A craving for affection or comfort food may run high. Ask for what you need plainly rather than sulking or overindulging.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Mercury: Graceful words and pleasant conversation. Good for love letters, tactful negotiations and anything needing a light touch.
transits.Venus|Flow|Mercury: Sociable, friendly communications. A good day for a pleasant chat, creative writing, or smoothing a disagreement.
transits.Venus|Tension|Mercury: Small talk may feel superficial, or you may avoid a hard truth to keep the peace. Kindness and honesty can coexist.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Venus: Your Venus return: a fresh cycle in love, pleasure and what you value. Notice what truly delights you and invest in it.
transits.Venus|Flow|Venus: Love and pleasure flow easily. A sweet day for relationships, art and enjoying the good things.
transits.Venus|Tension|Venus: Your tastes or affections may feel out of step with someone else's. Small differences in what you each want are worth talking about.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Mars: Attraction and passion heat up. A day for romance, creative fire and going after what you desire.
transits.Venus|Flow|Mars: Desire and affection work together. Good for romance, flirting and creative projects with real energy behind them.
transits.Venus|Tension|Mars: Wanting and getting may be out of sync — passion with friction. Avoid playing games; say what you want directly.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Jupiter: Generosity, good fortune and enjoyment. A lovely day for celebration and gifts — though it is easy to overspend or overindulge.
transits.Venus|Flow|Jupiter: Warm-hearted and lucky in small ways. Good for socialising, treating someone, or a little luxury.
transits.Venus|Tension|Jupiter: Too much of a good thing: extravagance and overpromising in love or money. Enjoy, but set a limit first.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Saturn: Love and pleasure meet responsibility. Feelings may be reserved, but commitments made now are meant seriously; show care through reliability.
transits.Venus|Flow|Saturn: Steady affection and sensible choices about money and relationships. Good for committing, or for honouring an old bond.
transits.Venus|Tension|Saturn: You may feel unloved, lonely or short of funds for a day or two. It passes; avoid harsh judgements about your worth.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden attractions and a taste for the unusual. Enjoy the spark, but don't mistake excitement for commitment.
transits.Venus|Flow|Uranus: Fresh air in love and friendship. Try something new together, or meet someone outside your usual circle.
transits.Venus|Tension|Uranus: Restlessness in relationships and impulsive spending. Give yourself and others some freedom rather than forcing a break.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Neptune: Romantic, idealistic and artistically inspired. Beautiful for art and compassion; keep one foot on the ground about people and purchases.
transits.Venus|Flow|Neptune: Tenderness, imagination and compassion. Lovely for romance, music and acts of kindness.
transits.Venus|Tension|Neptune: Rose-tinted glasses: you may idealise someone or overlook a flaw. Enjoy the dream, but postpone big decisions about love or money.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Pluto: Intense feelings and deep attractions. Love goes all the way down today; avoid jealousy and possessiveness.
transits.Venus|Flow|Pluto: Deep emotional connection and passionate creativity. Good for intimacy, and for honest talks about what you truly value.
transits.Venus|Tension|Pluto: Jealousy, control or obsession may surface in relationships or spending. Notice the intensity without acting it out.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|North Node: People you meet or enjoy today may matter for your path. Let pleasure and connection point the way.
transits.Venus|Flow|North Node: Relationships and pleasures support your growth. Accept an invitation that takes you slightly out of your comfort zone.
transits.Venus|Tension|North Node: Comfortable relationship patterns may pull you backward. Choose what helps you grow over what is merely easy.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Chiron: Tenderness around old hurts in love or self-worth. A kind word — given or received — can be genuinely healing.
transits.Venus|Flow|Chiron: Love heals. A good day for mending a rift, self-acceptance and gentle affection.
transits.Venus|Tension|Chiron: Insecurities about being lovable may surface. Don't seek reassurance in the wrong places; be kind to yourself.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Lilith: Sensual, magnetic and unapologetic. Honour your desires — and be aware of the stir they cause.
transits.Venus|Flow|Lilith: You can enjoy desire and independence together. Trust your own taste and attractions.
transits.Venus|Tension|Lilith: Desire and the wish for approval pull apart. Don't trade your authenticity for being liked.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Ascendant: You look and feel attractive, and people are drawn to you. Great for first impressions, dates and beauty treatments.
transits.Venus|Flow|Ascendant: You are charming and easy to like today. A good day for socialising and smoothing relationships.
transits.Venus|Tension|Ascendant: You may bend too far to please, or relationships may ask for compromise. Be gracious without losing yourself.
transits.Venus|Conjunction|Midheaven: Popularity at work and in public. Good for presentations, networking, and anything relying on charm or aesthetics.
transits.Venus|Flow|Midheaven: Goodwill smooths professional matters. A good day to ask for a favour or to showcase creative work.
transits.Venus|Tension|Midheaven: Pleasure and duty compete; you may prefer socialising to working. Keep professional relationships pleasant but clear.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Sun: A surge of energy, courage and competitiveness. Start something, exercise hard, assert yourself — and watch for haste and accidents.
transits.Mars|Flow|Sun: Strong, well-directed energy. A great few days to take initiative and get things done.
transits.Mars|Tension|Sun: Friction with others and a short temper. Pick your battles and burn off the energy physically; avoid risky shortcuts.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Moon: Emotions run hot — irritable, passionate, impatient. Be active rather than reactive, especially at home.
transits.Mars|Flow|Moon: Emotional courage. Good for tackling household projects or standing up for your needs.
transits.Mars|Tension|Moon: Moodiness and domestic squabbles are likely. Don't take things personally; give everyone some space.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Mercury: Sharp, fast thinking and forceful speech. Good for debate and quick decisions; beware of arguments and rushing on the road.
transits.Mars|Flow|Mercury: Decisive thinking and persuasive speech. Tackle demanding mental work or a tough conversation.
transits.Mars|Tension|Mercury: Arguments, sarcasm and hasty words. Think before sending that message, and take extra care when travelling.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Venus: Desire and attraction ignite. Romantic and creative energy are both strong — pursue what you want with warmth.
transits.Mars|Flow|Venus: Passion and affection in balance. A lovely time for romance, dancing, or putting energy into creative work.
transits.Mars|Tension|Venus: Sexual or relational tension: wants clash and tempers flare. Be direct but considerate.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Mars: Your Mars return: a new two-year cycle of drive and ambition begins. Set a goal that excites you and take the first step.
transits.Mars|Flow|Mars: Your energy works for you. Good for physical activity and steady, confident progress on your goals.
transits.Mars|Tension|Mars: Your drive meets obstacles. Frustration may build; adjust your approach rather than pushing harder.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Jupiter: Bold, enthusiastic action. A great time for ambitious starts and competition — just don't overreach.
transits.Mars|Flow|Jupiter: Confident, well-timed action. Good for launching projects, sport, and taking a calculated risk.
transits.Mars|Tension|Jupiter: Overconfidence and excess. You may bite off more than you can chew; aim high, but pace yourself.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Saturn: Energy meets a brick wall — or becomes disciplined endurance. Work patiently on something hard; don't force what won't move.
transits.Mars|Flow|Saturn: Disciplined, sustained effort. Excellent for difficult tasks requiring patience and control.
transits.Mars|Tension|Saturn: Frustration, blockages and stop-start progress. Avoid forcing things; conserve energy and handle one obstacle at a time.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Uranus: Impulsive, rebellious energy. Excellent for breaking a rut; take care with speed, tools and tempers.
transits.Mars|Flow|Uranus: Inventive, daring action. Try a new approach or act on an original idea.
transits.Mars|Tension|Uranus: Sudden upsets and accident-prone haste. Slow down, stay flexible, and avoid rash confrontations.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Neptune: Energy is diffuse; motivation may waver. Good for acting on ideals, creative or charitable work; avoid deception and overexertion.
transits.Mars|Flow|Neptune: Energy flows toward what inspires you. A good few days to put real effort into creative, spiritual or compassionate pursuits — action guided by imagination rather than ambition.
transits.Mars|Tension|Neptune: Low energy, confusion about what you want, or misdirected effort. Rest more, and avoid passive-aggression.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Pluto: Tremendous drive and willpower. You can move mountains; avoid ruthlessness and power struggles.
transits.Mars|Flow|Pluto: Deep reserves of energy and determination. Excellent for major efforts and transforming a situation.
transits.Mars|Tension|Pluto: Power struggles and intense confrontations. Don't try to dominate, and stay out of dangerous situations.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|North Node: A push to act on your life direction. Take a bold step toward what you're meant to do.
transits.Mars|Flow|North Node: Your efforts line up with where your life is heading. Act on an opening for growth while the momentum is with you.
transits.Mars|Tension|North Node: Impulses may pull you off course. Pause and ask whether an action serves your long-term direction.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Chiron: Old anger or wounds around assertiveness may flare. Channel it into courageous, healing action.
transits.Mars|Flow|Chiron: Courage to face a sore spot. Take a constructive step to heal an old hurt.
transits.Mars|Tension|Chiron: Touchiness and defensive reactions. Notice where you feel powerless, and respond rather than lash out.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Lilith: Raw desire and defiance. Powerful for reclaiming your autonomy; watch for provoking conflict.
transits.Mars|Flow|Lilith: Instinct and action agree. Go after what you want and stand up for yourself plainly — no apology and no drama needed.
transits.Mars|Tension|Lilith: Anger at being controlled or shamed may erupt. Assert your boundaries without burning bridges.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Ascendant: You come across as forceful and energetic. Great for taking the lead; mind you don't seem aggressive.
transits.Mars|Flow|Ascendant: Energetic, confident self-presentation. Good for physical activity and making things happen.
transits.Mars|Tension|Ascendant: Conflicts with others, especially partners, are more likely. Stand your ground without picking fights.
transits.Mars|Conjunction|Midheaven: Ambition is fired up. Push ahead with career goals, but avoid clashing with authority figures.
transits.Mars|Flow|Midheaven: Energy for your professional goals is strong and well received. Take the initiative at work, or start the task that moves your ambitions forward.
transits.Mars|Tension|Midheaven: Tension between work and home, or conflict with bosses. Channel the drive into the work itself rather than the argument.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Sun: A once-in-twelve-years boost to confidence, health and opportunity. Doors open more easily in these weeks — aim higher, and say yes to growth.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Sun: A period of ease, optimism and good fortune. Use the favourable wind to advance your goals rather than just coasting.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Sun: Confidence runs high — perhaps too high. Opportunities are real, but overextending or arrogance can undermine them. Grow, but within your means.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Moon: Emotional generosity and a sense of abundance. A good period for home, family and feeling at peace; watch a tendency to overindulge.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Moon: Contentment and emotional wellbeing. Home life and close relationships benefit; a good time to improve your living situation.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Moon: Emotions are amplified, and you may overreact or overindulge. Enjoy the warmth, but keep feelings in proportion.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Mercury: Your thinking expands: big plans, study, travel, publishing. A great period to learn, teach or make an important agreement — read the details.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Mercury: Optimistic thinking and good judgement. Favourable for study, contracts, writing and travel plans.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Mercury: Grand ideas with overlooked details. Think big, but check facts and avoid overpromising.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Venus: One of the happiest contacts of the year: love, friendship, pleasure and money flow more freely. Enjoy it, and share it.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Venus: Sociable, affectionate and fortunate. A lovely period for romance, celebrations and financial ease.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Venus: Extravagance in love or spending. Pleasure is plentiful; the bill comes later. Enjoy with some restraint.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Mars: Energy, courage and enterprise are multiplied. Excellent for bold initiatives; avoid recklessness.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Mars: Effort pays off handsomely. A strong period for ambitious projects, sport and business ventures.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Mars: Overconfidence and impatience. You may take on too much or push too hard; channel the energy wisely.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Jupiter: Your Jupiter return — a twelve-year milestone. A new cycle of growth, learning and opportunity begins; think about where you want to expand.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Jupiter: Growth feels natural and well supported. A good period to broaden your horizons through study or travel.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Jupiter: A check on how you've been growing: too much, too fast, or in the wrong direction? Adjust your aims.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Saturn: Opportunity meets structure. Hard work is recognised, and long-term plans gain support; build patiently.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Saturn: Balanced, sustainable growth. Favourable for business, career planning and practical expansion.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Saturn: A tug between expansion and caution. Restlessness with limits; make changes deliberately rather than abruptly.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden opportunities and a hunger for freedom. Lucky breaks favour the bold and unconventional.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Uranus: Fortunate surprises and fresh perspectives arrive in this period. Welcome new ideas, technologies and people; a small experiment could open a larger door.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Uranus: Restlessness and risky impulses. Change is tempting, but avoid gambling your stability for excitement.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Neptune: Idealism, compassion and imagination expand. Wonderful for spiritual or artistic growth; keep finances grounded.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Neptune: Faith and inspiration are easy to find. A good period for creative, charitable and spiritual pursuits, and for trusting that things can work out.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Neptune: Wishful thinking and unrealistic schemes. Dream, but verify before investing money or trust.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Pluto: Ambition and personal power grow. You can achieve significant success through focused effort; use the influence well.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Pluto: Opportunities to increase your influence and to change things for the better. Good for major undertakings.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Pluto: Power struggles or obsession with success. Ambition is strong; avoid ruthless or fanatical tactics.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|North Node: Fortunate encounters and opportunities aligned with your life path. Say yes to growth that feels meaningful.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|North Node: Support for your long-term direction comes easily. Take advantage of helpful people and openings.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|North Node: Opportunities may tempt you off course. Choose growth that fits your real direction.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Chiron: Healing through understanding and faith. A teacher, a journey or a new perspective may help mend an old wound.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Chiron: A period of healing and renewed hope. Good for therapy, study and helping others.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Chiron: Old insecurities are magnified. Don't overcompensate; seek genuine healing over quick fixes.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Lilith: Your wild, independent side grows bolder. Good for claiming freedom; avoid excess and scandal.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Lilith: Confidence in your unconventional nature grows. Express yourself freely and without shame; your independence wins more respect than you expect.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Lilith: Rebellion or indulgence may go too far. Honour your desires without being ruled by them.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Ascendant: A new twelve-year chapter of personal growth. You radiate confidence and attract opportunities — and may gain weight along with stature.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Ascendant: Optimism and good relations. People respond well to you; good for partnerships and self-improvement.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Ascendant: Overconfidence or overpromising in relationships. Be generous, but realistic about commitments.
transits.Jupiter|Conjunction|Midheaven: A career peak: recognition, promotion or a new professional direction are favoured. Aim high and be visible.
transits.Jupiter|Flow|Midheaven: Professional growth with support from superiors. A good period to advance your goals.
transits.Jupiter|Tension|Midheaven: Ambition may outrun readiness, or work and home compete. Expand carefully and keep the balance.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Sun: A serious, defining period that comes round every twenty-nine years. Responsibilities weigh heavily and energy may be lower, but what you build now on honest foundations lasts.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Sun: A steady, productive period. Discipline comes naturally and efforts are rewarded with lasting results and respect.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Sun: A testing time: obstacles, heavy duties and tired spirits. Don't quit; cut what is unnecessary, look after your health, and persevere.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Moon: Emotional heaviness and a sense of duty. You may feel lonely or burdened, but you are building emotional maturity; ask for support.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Moon: Emotional stability and common sense. A good period to settle domestic matters and build secure routines.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Moon: Feelings of isolation or being unsupported. Tend to your emotional needs deliberately; this period teaches self-reliance.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Mercury: Thinking becomes serious and focused. Excellent for study and detailed work; guard against pessimism and worry.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Mercury: Thinking is clear, orderly and realistic. A good period for planning, study, paperwork and decisions that need a cool head.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Mercury: Mental strain, doubt or communication blocks. Take your time; rework ideas rather than abandoning them.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Venus: Relationships are tested for their substance. Commitments deepen or end; affection may feel cool, but what is real lasts.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Venus: Love and money both benefit from steadiness now. A good period to make or renew a commitment and to put finances on a sound footing.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Venus: Loneliness, relationship strain or financial limits. See what is truly valuable; don't settle out of fear.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Mars: Energy is restrained and must be used carefully. Hard, disciplined effort achieves much; forcing things causes breakage.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Mars: Controlled, enduring effort. A strong period for demanding work and long-term goals.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Mars: Frustration and blocked initiative. Work steadily within limits; avoid anger and overexertion.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Jupiter: Growth meets a reality check. Consolidate your gains, and turn hopes into concrete plans.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Jupiter: Optimism becomes practical. Build carefully on the opportunities you already have; modest, well-planned growth made now tends to last.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Jupiter: Your beliefs and plans are tested by limits. Adjust your expectations and commit to what is workable.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Saturn: Your Saturn return — a major life milestone around ages 29 and 58. You are asked to take full responsibility for your life; restructure what no longer fits.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Saturn: A period of steady progress and maturity. The structures you've built support you; strengthen them.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Saturn: A turning point in a long cycle. Pressure reveals what needs to change in your commitments and structures.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Uranus: Tension between freedom and responsibility. Give your original ideas a workable, lasting form.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Uranus: Innovation finds a workable form. A good period to make considered changes — updating how you live or work without throwing away what serves you.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Uranus: The old and the new collide. Restlessness against restrictions; avoid both rigid resistance and reckless breakouts.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Neptune: Dreams meet reality. Illusions dissolve; ground your ideals in practical effort.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Neptune: You can give form to your dreams. A good period for disciplined creative or spiritual work.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Neptune: Confusion, doubt or disillusionment. Be honest about what's real; avoid both escapism and cynicism.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Pluto: A period of deep restructuring. Old foundations may crumble; rebuild with integrity and patience.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Pluto: Powerful endurance and focus. You can achieve lasting transformation through disciplined effort.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Pluto: Heavy pressure and power struggles with authority. Let go of what is beyond saving; be patient and thorough.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|North Node: A serious commitment to your life direction. Responsibilities arrive that shape your path for years.
transits.Saturn|Flow|North Node: Steady progress along your path. Discipline and the advice of experienced people help more than shortcuts; commit to the long route.
transits.Saturn|Tension|North Node: Obligations may seem to block your growth. Work through them; they are part of the path.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Chiron: An old wound demands to be dealt with seriously. Painful, but an opportunity for real, lasting healing.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Chiron: Patient, steady work on healing pays off. Structure and routine support your recovery.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Chiron: Old hurts feel heavy and authority figures may trigger them. Be patient with your healing; don't harden.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Lilith: Your instincts meet rules and judgement. Find mature, responsible ways to honour your independence.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Lilith: You can give your untamed side a constructive outlet. Hold your boundaries with quiet authority.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Lilith: You may feel repressed, shamed or constrained. Don't deny your needs; assert them calmly and firmly.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Ascendant: A new chapter of self-definition. You feel the weight of responsibility and may appear more serious; take care of your health and simplify.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Ascendant: Maturity and reliability earn respect. A good period to strengthen commitments and build healthy habits.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Ascendant: Relationships and commitments are tested. Burdens feel heavy; set boundaries and honour real obligations.
transits.Saturn|Conjunction|Midheaven: A career culmination: years of effort come to a peak of responsibility and recognition — or a reckoning. Live up to it.
transits.Saturn|Flow|Midheaven: Your reliability is noticed. Professional progress is steady rather than sudden, so take on responsibility and let consistent work speak for you.
transits.Saturn|Tension|Midheaven: Pressure at work or between career and home. Heavy demands test your foundations; prioritise and persevere.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Sun: A once-in-a-lifetime awakening. You need to be more authentically yourself, and life may change suddenly to make that possible. Embrace the change consciously rather than letting it happen to you.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Sun: An exciting, freeing period. New interests and opportunities let you express your individuality; experiment.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Sun: Restlessness and upheaval. Sudden changes challenge your sense of self and stability; make room for freedom before it forces its way in.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Moon: Emotional upheaval and changes at home. Old emotional patterns break up; you are being freed from habits that confine you.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Moon: Emotional freshness and openness to change. A good period to update your living situation or emotional habits.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Moon: Emotional volatility and domestic disruption. You crave space; make changes thoughtfully rather than impulsively.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Mercury: Your thinking is revolutionised. Brilliant insights and new interests arrive; your nerves may be on edge, so calm the mind.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Mercury: Inventive, quick thinking. A stimulating period for learning new subjects and technologies.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Mercury: A scattered, overstimulated mind and abrupt speech. Great ideas, but nervous tension; slow down and double-check.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Venus: Excitement and upheaval in love and values. Sudden attractions, or a need for freedom in relationships; your tastes change.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Venus: Refreshing changes in your social and love life. New people and unconventional pleasures enliven you.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Venus: Instability in relationships or finances. A craving for excitement may upset commitments; find freedom within them.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Mars: Explosive energy and an urge to break free. Powerful for bold change; take care with haste, anger and accidents.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Mars: Daring, original action. A good period to start innovative projects and take the initiative.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Mars: Impulsiveness, rebellion and accident-proneness. Channel the restless energy into constructive change; avoid rash acts.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Jupiter: Sudden opportunities and a broadened outlook. A lucky break or a liberating change of belief is possible.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Jupiter: Fortunate changes and wider horizons. An unexpected opportunity may arrive in these months; say yes to something new and see where it leads.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Jupiter: Restlessness and overconfidence combine. Sudden schemes look tempting in this period; weigh the risks before you leap, and keep a reserve.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Saturn: Your structures are shaken so they can be renewed. Old rules and obligations give way to new forms; stay flexible.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Saturn: Change comes in a constructive form. You can modernise your life and work in this period while keeping the structures that still serve you.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Saturn: Strain between security and freedom. Rigid structures may crack; reform them rather than cling or flee.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Uranus: Your Uranus return, around age 84: a full circle that offers freedom from old expectations and a fresh look at your life.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Uranus: A period of easy renewal. You can make changes that reflect who you've become.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Uranus: A generational turning point — the squares near ages 21 and 63, the opposition near 42. An urge for freedom prompts you to re-examine your direction.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Neptune: Imagination and intuition wake up. Sudden insights dissolve old illusions in this period; give yourself time to absorb a changed view of what you believe.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Neptune: Intuition and creative breakthroughs come more readily. Follow a visionary idea a little further than you normally would.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Neptune: Ideals are unsettled and it can be hard to tell inspiration from wishful thinking. Stay grounded in practical routines while your beliefs rearrange themselves.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Pluto: A deep and liberating change is under way. Long-standing patterns are disrupted and released; cooperate with it rather than trying to restore the old order.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Pluto: Change feels empowering rather than threatening. You can break through an old limitation decisively in this period — pick the one that matters most.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Pluto: Pressure to change is intense, and upheavals or contests of will are possible. Loosen your grip; what breaks now was ready to go.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|North Node: A sudden turn in your life path. Unexpected people or events redirect you toward your future.
transits.Uranus|Flow|North Node: Freeing changes support your growth. The unconventional route is the right one in this period — follow what feels alive rather than what is expected.
transits.Uranus|Tension|North Node: Disruptions seem to knock you off course. Stay open: the detour may turn out to be the path, and resisting it costs more than exploring it.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Chiron: A sudden jolt to an old wound brings the chance of a breakthrough in healing. New, unconventional approaches help.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Chiron: Fresh insight reaches an old hurt. Try an approach to healing you have not considered before; a new angle can release what effort alone could not.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Chiron: Unexpected events may reopen an old wound. Respond with awareness rather than alarm — the jolt is also a chance to see the hurt differently.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Lilith: Your wild side breaks free. A radical assertion of independence; avoid shock for its own sake.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Lilith: You are free to be unconventional. Let your authentic, untamed side show in this period; it is easier now and costs you less than hiding it.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Lilith: Rebellion against constraints flares. Ask what you actually need to be free of; real liberation matters more than a gesture of defiance.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Ascendant: A dramatic change in how you present yourself and approach life. You reinvent yourself; freedom is essential now.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Ascendant: Fresh self-expression and exciting new contacts. Update your image and try new things.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Ascendant: Sudden changes in relationships and in how others see you. Give yourself and your partners room.
transits.Uranus|Conjunction|Midheaven: A sudden change of career or life direction. You need more freedom and authenticity in your work.
transits.Uranus|Flow|Midheaven: Your working life opens to something new. Embrace unfamiliar tools, roles or unconventional opportunities — they suit you better than the old routine.
transits.Uranus|Tension|Midheaven: Career and home are both unsettled, and your standing may shift without warning. Stay adaptable and keep your options open.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Sun: A long, subtle dissolving of your old sense of self. Ego boundaries blur; you may feel lost or deeply inspired. Nurture your imagination and compassion, and avoid escapism.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Sun: Heightened creativity, intuition and compassion. A good period for artistic and spiritual growth.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Sun: Confusion about identity and direction, low vitality. Don't make big commitments in the fog; rest, and wait for clarity.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Moon: Emotional sensitivity is extreme. Psychic impressions, longing and vulnerability; protect yourself from other people's moods.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Moon: Empathy and emotional attunement deepen. A nourishing period for creative and spiritual life; let yourself be moved by music, water and quiet.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Moon: Emotional confusion and vague anxieties. Avoid escapism; ground yourself in simple routines.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Mercury: The mind becomes imaginative and intuitive, but less precise. Wonderful for creative writing; take extra care with facts and agreements.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Mercury: Thinking turns intuitive and poetic. A good period for the arts, for reading between the lines, and for understanding what is not said outright.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Mercury: Foggy thinking, miscommunication or deception. Verify information and put agreements in writing.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Venus: Romantic idealism at its peak. Love feels transcendent; artistic inspiration flows. See people as they are, not only as you wish them to be.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Venus: Tender, compassionate love and refined artistic taste. A beautiful period for romance and creativity.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Venus: Illusions in love or money. Disappointment is possible if you idealise; keep your eyes open.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Mars: Drive becomes diffuse or inspired. Act for something greater than yourself; avoid drifting or martyrdom.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Mars: Action is guided by inspiration. Put your energy into creative, humanitarian or spiritual aims; effort made for something beyond yourself goes furthest.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Mars: Drive is weaker and motives are harder to read, including your own. Avoid anything underhand; rest more, and pursue your goals with plain honesty.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Jupiter: Idealism and faith expand. Great spiritual hunger; beware of gullibility and grandiose dreams.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Jupiter: Compassion, generosity and an inspired outlook. A good period for spiritual and charitable pursuits, and for renewing your sense of meaning.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Jupiter: Optimism outruns the facts. Avoid speculative ventures and anyone offering easy answers; keep the dream, but check the numbers.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Saturn: Your structures soften. Old certainties and ambitions dissolve; rebuild with meaning in mind.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Saturn: Dreams can be given form. This is practical idealism at its best — patient, disciplined work on something you believe in pays off.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Saturn: Anxiety as the solid becomes uncertain. Fears may be exaggerated; maintain simple disciplines.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Uranus: Intuition and ideals awaken together. Wider currents of the time inspire personal change; follow the vision, but anchor it in something concrete.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Uranus: Flashes of intuition come more readily, and they are worth trusting. Give a visionary idea room, and note it down before it fades.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Uranus: Changes arrive in a confusing form. Take time to sift real inspiration from illusion before you rearrange your life around it.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Neptune: A Neptune return, some 165 years after birth — beyond any lifetime, but a marker for a legacy. The ideals and dreams this chart stands for come round again and are seen afresh.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Neptune: A gentle period of spiritual and imaginative growth, typically near ages 28 and 55. Your ideals mature naturally.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Neptune: A midlife test of your dreams and ideals, near age 41. Disillusionment clears the way for truer visions.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Pluto: Deep, subtle transformation of your inner life. Spiritual forces work beneath the surface.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Pluto: A slow, deep renewal of your inner life. Trust change that works beneath the surface; you need not force or even understand it yet.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Pluto: Hidden compulsions surface in confusing ways. Look for honest insight — with help if needed — rather than escape.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|North Node: Your path takes on a spiritual or imaginative dimension. Follow inspiration, but stay discerning.
transits.Neptune|Flow|North Node: Intuition guides your direction well in this period. Pay attention to subtle signs and quiet inclinations; they point the right way.
transits.Neptune|Tension|North Node: Your direction feels uncertain and it is easy to drift. Put your real aims into plain words and take one small, concrete step.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Chiron: Deep, compassionate healing of old wounds. Sensitivity is high; forgiveness becomes possible.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Chiron: Gentle healing comes through compassion, art or spiritual practice. Old hurts soften without needing to be argued with.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Chiron: Old pain may feel overwhelming or hard to name. Seek support and stay present with it; numbing it only postpones the healing.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Lilith: Hidden desires and fantasies surface in a haze. Explore them honestly; avoid self-deception.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Lilith: Instinct and imagination blend. A period of creative, sensual inspiration — let desire speak through art, dreams or play.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Lilith: Desire is tangled with confusion, shame or temptation. Be honest with yourself about what you want before acting on it.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Ascendant: Your self-image and approach to life become fluid. You are more sensitive, glamorous or elusive; take care of your health and boundaries.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Ascendant: You come across as sensitive, charismatic and a little magical. Others find you inspiring; a good period for creative self-expression.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Ascendant: Confusion in relationships and in how you present yourself. Beware of deception — yours or others'.
transits.Neptune|Conjunction|Midheaven: Career direction dissolves and re-forms around your ideals. You may be drawn to artistic, healing or spiritual work; avoid vague ambitions.
transits.Neptune|Flow|Midheaven: Inspiration in your vocation. Your imagination and compassion are assets at work.
transits.Neptune|Tension|Midheaven: Uncertainty about career or home. Avoid illusions about your position; seek clarity before big moves.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Sun: A profound, once-in-a-lifetime transformation of identity. Old versions of you die away; you emerge more powerful and authentic. Let go rather than cling.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Sun: Empowerment and regeneration. You can make deep, positive changes and increase your influence.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Sun: Intense pressure and power struggles force change. What you resist persists; release control and rebuild.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Moon: Deep emotional transformation. Buried feelings and family patterns surface for healing; home life may change fundamentally.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Moon: Feelings deepen and renew. You can heal an old emotional pattern in this period — it loosens when you look at it squarely.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Moon: Emotional upheaval and intensity. Old feelings erupt; let them be purged, without manipulation.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Mercury: Your thinking is transformed. Penetrating insight, obsessive focus; your words gain power — use them carefully.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Mercury: Deep, persuasive thinking. Excellent for research, psychology and influential communication.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Mercury: Obsessive thoughts and verbal power struggles. Don't force your views; question fixed ideas.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Venus: Love and values are transformed. Intense relationships, deep attractions, and endings that make way for truer bonds.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Venus: Love deepens and creative power grows. Relationships become more honest and more intense; let them change you for the better.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Venus: Jealousy, control or upheaval in relationships and finances. Let go of what is not authentic.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Mars: Enormous drive and willpower. You can achieve the near-impossible; avoid ruthlessness and danger.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Mars: Sustained power and determination are yours to use. An excellent period for a major effort, especially one you have been afraid to begin.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Mars: Power struggles and volcanic anger. Avoid confrontations of will; direct the force into transformation.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Jupiter: Ambition and beliefs are intensified. Great success through total commitment; avoid fanaticism.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Jupiter: Opportunities for real growth and influence appear. Commit fully to one of them; half-measures waste what this period offers.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Jupiter: Ambition may overreach, or beliefs harden into dogma. Use whatever power you gain ethically, and stay open to being wrong.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Saturn: Your foundations are transformed. Structures break down and are rebuilt stronger; a demanding, maturing period.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Saturn: Transformation proceeds in a disciplined way. You can rebuild part of your life on solid ground — slowly, and for good.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Saturn: Heavy pressure falls on your structures and security. Persevere, and shed what has become obsolete rather than propping it up.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Uranus: A radical inner change. Your need for freedom becomes compelling in this period and remakes more of your life than you expected.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Uranus: Breakthroughs feel empowering. Embrace deep change in this period; the part of you that wants freedom and the part that wants power agree.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Uranus: Upheaval is disruptive and hard to avoid. Change is coming either way; cooperate with it and choose what to release.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Neptune: Your ideals and spiritual life are profoundly remade. What you believed without question is dissolved and slowly replaced by something truer.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Neptune: Deep spiritual renewal and inspired insight. Let imagination and intuition lead you to what needs to change.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Neptune: Illusions are stripped away. It is painful, but clarifying — what remains afterwards is what you can actually rely on.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Pluto: A Pluto return, some 248 years after birth — beyond any lifetime, but a marker for a legacy. What this chart set in motion is taken apart and remade for a new era.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Pluto: A period of natural empowerment, when deep change comes without crisis. Use it to let go of something outgrown.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Pluto: A generational turning point, often in midlife. You confront questions of power and mortality, and shed an old skin.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|North Node: A fated turn in your life path. Powerful encounters and events transform your direction.
transits.Pluto|Flow|North Node: Deep change supports your growth. Commit fully to your path in this period; the effort you put in reshapes more than you can yet see.
transits.Pluto|Tension|North Node: Intense pressures challenge your direction. Let go of old attachments holding you back.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Chiron: Your deepest wound is brought to the surface for profound healing. Intense, but transformative.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Chiron: Deep healing is possible. Face an old pain directly and you can reclaim the strength that was tied up in it.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Chiron: Old wounds are painfully reopened. Seek support; healing comes through facing them.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Lilith: Your shadow and raw instincts are intensified. Reclaim your power; beware of obsession.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Lilith: Embracing your untamed self is empowering now. What you were taught to hide turns out to be a source of strength.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Lilith: Power struggles gather around desire, shame and control. Face the shadow honestly rather than acting it out or blaming it on someone else.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Ascendant: A total transformation of how you meet the world. You become more intense, powerful and private; an old identity is shed.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Ascendant: Personal empowerment and magnetic presence. You can remake your image and relationships.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Ascendant: Intense relationships and power struggles transform you. Release controlling patterns.
transits.Pluto|Conjunction|Midheaven: Your career and public role are transformed. Ambition intensifies; you may rise to power or completely change direction.
transits.Pluto|Flow|Midheaven: Your influence in your profession grows. A period for significant, lasting changes to your work and standing.
transits.Pluto|Tension|Midheaven: Upheaval in career or home. Power struggles with authority; rebuild from the foundations.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Sun: The currents of the time favour your self-expression. Important people and opportunities arrive; step forward and be seen.
transits.North Node|Flow|Sun: Life supports your personal goals. Connections made now further your purpose.
transits.North Node|Tension|Sun: Your personal aims and the direction of events are at odds. Adjust your course without abandoning yourself.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Moon: Emotionally significant encounters, often with women or family. Your needs align with the times; trust your feelings about where you belong.
transits.North Node|Flow|Moon: Supportive emotional connections. Home and family ties help you move forward.
transits.North Node|Tension|Moon: Emotional needs conflict with outside demands. Old habits pull back; choose growth gently.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Mercury: Meaningful conversations, news and ideas. A good period for learning, and for contacts that open doors.
transits.North Node|Flow|Mercury: Helpful information and useful contacts come your way. Speak up, ask questions and stay in touch — a conversation now can open a door.
transits.North Node|Tension|Mercury: Your ideas may be out of step with others. Listen, adapt your message, and avoid gossip.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Venus: Significant relationships and pleasant social ties form. Love or partnership may feel fated.
transits.North Node|Flow|Venus: Harmonious connections and social ease. Good for relationships and for agreements.
transits.North Node|Tension|Venus: Relationship needs clash with circumstances. Re-examine what and whom you value.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Mars: Energetic teamwork and decisive joint action. You are pushed to act with others toward a goal.
transits.North Node|Flow|Mars: Your initiative finds support from others. A good period for collaborative efforts and for acting with a team behind you.
transits.North Node|Tension|Mars: Conflict with others over goals. Assert yourself without alienating your allies.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Jupiter: Fortunate associations and openings for growth. Mentors and benefactors appear in this period; accept the help.
transits.North Node|Flow|Jupiter: Beneficial contacts widen your horizons. Accept invitations and introductions; one of them leads somewhere worthwhile.
transits.North Node|Tension|Jupiter: Associations look more promising than they are. Choose alliances carefully, and be wary of joining something merely because it flatters you.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Saturn: Serious, karmic-feeling responsibilities and relationships with elders or authority. Commit to what matters.
transits.North Node|Flow|Saturn: Reliable, long-lasting associations form or strengthen. Progress is steady and supported; value the people who show up consistently.
transits.North Node|Tension|Saturn: Obligations feel heavy or isolating. Fulfil your duties, but don't cut yourself off.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden, unusual encounters that change your direction. New groups and ideas energise you.
transits.North Node|Flow|Uranus: Exciting new contacts and chances for change. People from outside your usual circle have something to offer.
transits.North Node|Tension|Uranus: Associations are disrupted, or you feel hemmed in by a group. Protect your freedom, but leave gracefully rather than burning bridges.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Neptune: Idealistic or spiritual associations. Inspiring connections; stay discerning about others' motives.
transits.North Node|Flow|Neptune: Intuitive, compassionate links with others. You may find your people in creative or spiritual settings.
transits.North Node|Tension|Neptune: Confusion or misplaced trust in groups. Make your expectations explicit, and check that others' ideals match their actions.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Pluto: Powerful, transformative associations. Encounters now can change your life; mind the power dynamics.
transits.North Node|Flow|Pluto: Influential connections strengthen your hand. Alliances made in this period can carry real weight; choose them with care.
transits.North Node|Tension|Pluto: Power struggles within groups or close relationships. Refuse to manipulate or be manipulated, and step back from contests of control.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|North Node: Your nodal return, every eighteen to nineteen years: a renewal of life direction. New paths and people appear in step with your purpose.
transits.North Node|Flow|North Node: A supportive phase in your nodal cycle. Progress on your path comes easily.
transits.North Node|Tension|North Node: A crossroads in your nodal cycle — the half-return around ages 9, 27, 46 and 65, and the squares between. Past and future pull against each other; choose your direction consciously.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Chiron: Encounters that touch an old wound and offer healing. A mentor or healer may appear.
transits.North Node|Flow|Chiron: Healing connections support your growth. Someone who has been through what you have can help — and you can help them.
transits.North Node|Tension|Chiron: Relationships may stir old hurts in this period. Painful as that is, each encounter is also a chance to heal.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Lilith: Encounters that awaken your untamed side. You're drawn toward greater authenticity.
transits.North Node|Flow|Lilith: The times favour your independent instincts. You can be more fully yourself among others without having to fight for it.
transits.North Node|Tension|Lilith: Tension between belonging and autonomy. Be yourself without isolating yourself.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Ascendant: Important new relationships and a sense of being in the right place. You're drawn into significant associations.
transits.North Node|Flow|Ascendant: Favourable contacts and easy cooperation. Others help you along in this period; let them.
transits.North Node|Tension|Ascendant: Attention shifts between your private and public life. Adjust how you relate to home and career.
transits.North Node|Conjunction|Midheaven: Career-defining connections and public recognition. Your goals align with the times.
transits.North Node|Flow|Midheaven: Helpful professional associations. Network on behalf of your goals — the right people are easier to reach now.
transits.North Node|Tension|Midheaven: The focus shifts away from status toward home, roots and close relationships. Rebalance accordingly.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Sun: A period when your deepest insecurity about who you are comes into view. Painful, but it brings wisdom and the capacity to help others; be compassionate with yourself.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Sun: Healing of old doubts about your worth. You can turn past hurts into strength and guidance for others.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Sun: Your confidence is tested by old wounds. Don't hide the vulnerability; working with it makes you more whole.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Moon: Old emotional and family wounds surface for healing. Tender feelings need gentle care; nurture yourself as you would a child.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Moon: Emotional healing flows naturally. A good period for therapy and mending family ties.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Moon: Emotional sore spots are easily triggered. Notice old patterns of feeling unsafe; seek comfort and support.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Mercury: Old hurts around communication or learning surface. You may find healing words — or realise how words have wounded you.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Mercury: Healing through talking, writing or study. You can teach from your experience.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Mercury: Sensitivity to criticism and misunderstanding. Speak kindly to yourself; question harsh inner talk.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Venus: Wounds in love and self-worth are stirred. A relationship may bring up old pain — and the chance to heal it.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Venus: Healing in relationships and in how you value yourself. Love — given, received or simply allowed — mends an old hurt.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Venus: Insecurity about being loved or valued. Don't settle or cling; address the underlying hurt.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Mars: Wounds around anger, assertion or sexuality come up. Learn to act from wholeness rather than hurt.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Mars: You have the courage to heal. Take one constructive action on an old injury, physical or otherwise, instead of working around it.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Mars: Frustration and a sense of powerlessness. Find healthy outlets for anger; act on your own behalf.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Jupiter: Healing through faith, learning and broader perspective. A teacher or a journey may help.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Jupiter: Growth comes through healing, and optimism returns. A teacher, a journey or a new perspective helps you make sense of an old hurt.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Jupiter: A crisis of faith or meaning. Question your beliefs; find a truer philosophy.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Saturn: Old fears and limitations are painfully felt, but can be worked with. Structure supports healing.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Saturn: Patient, lasting healing of old fears. Slow and steady work, a little at a time, changes more than a dramatic effort would.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Saturn: Feelings of inadequacy or of being burdened. Be patient; don't judge yourself harshly.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Uranus: A breakthrough around an old wound of being different. What once set you apart can now be embraced as what makes you yourself.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Uranus: Freeing insights ease a sense of not belonging. You see your differences in a new light, and they weigh less.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Uranus: You may feel like an outsider. Accept your individuality without cutting yourself off; others feel more like you than you think.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Neptune: Spiritual wounds and deep sensitivity come to the surface. Compassion and forgiveness — including for yourself — are what heal.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Neptune: Gentle spiritual healing. Quiet, art, nature or prayer reach a hurt that words have not.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Neptune: Disillusionment or a feeling of being a victim. Seek grounded spiritual support.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Pluto: Deep, intense healing of trauma. Buried pain surfaces to be transformed.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Pluto: Profound renewal comes through facing an old pain. What you have survived becomes a source of depth and strength.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Pluto: Painful encounters with power and loss. Seek support for healing that goes deep; this is not a period to manage alone.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|North Node: Healing becomes central to your path. Wounds point the way to your purpose.
transits.Chiron|Flow|North Node: Healing supports your growth and direction. What you have learned from being hurt is part of what you have to offer.
transits.Chiron|Tension|North Node: Old wounds seem to block your path. Addressing them frees you to move forward.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Chiron: Your Chiron return, around age 50: a major passage in which your life's central wound comes full circle, offering deep healing and the wisdom of the elder.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Chiron: A supportive phase of healing. Past hurts integrate more easily.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Chiron: A turning point in your healing journey. An old wound is reactivated to be understood at a new level.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Lilith: Wounds around shame, rejection and your instinctual nature surface. Reclaim what was exiled.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Lilith: Your relationship with desire and independence heals. Old shame loosens, and you can want what you want without apology.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Lilith: Shame or anger about instincts you were taught to suppress may surface. Meet these feelings with compassion rather than judgement.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Ascendant: You become more aware of your vulnerabilities and your gift for helping others. Your approach to life grows gentler and wiser.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Ascendant: Healing in how you present yourself and relate. Others sense your compassion.
