transits.Chiron|Tension|Ascendant: Sensitivity in relationships; others may mirror your wounds. Use these encounters to heal.
transits.Chiron|Conjunction|Midheaven: Your vocation is touched by healing. You may be called to teach, mentor or heal — or feel wounded in your public role.
transits.Chiron|Flow|Midheaven: Your experience of healing benefits your work. You may find yourself mentoring, teaching or simply being the person others confide in.
transits.Chiron|Tension|Midheaven: Insecurity about career or status. Address old feelings of not being good enough.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Sun: Your raw, uncompromising self demands expression. You may feel defiant or magnetic; refuse what diminishes you, without needing to shock.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Sun: You can be fully yourself, without apology. Instinct and identity work together.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Sun: A clash between who you're expected to be and your wilder nature. Honour what's been denied.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Moon: Deep, primal emotions surface — needs you may have been taught to hide. Give them honest attention.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Moon: Instinct and feeling are in harmony. Trust your gut in this period, especially about what and whom you need.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Moon: Emotional turbulence around rejection or unmet needs. Don't be ashamed of what you feel; ask what it is telling you.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Mercury: Taboo thoughts and blunt truths want voicing. Speak honestly, and consider the impact.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Mercury: You can voice unconventional ideas clearly and be heard. Say the thing others are avoiding — calmly.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Mercury: Sharp words or feeling silenced. Find a way to say what must be said.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Venus: Desire and magnetism intensify. Explore what you truly want in love; avoid manipulation.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Venus: Sensuality and independence blend gracefully. You can enjoy closeness without giving up your freedom.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Venus: A pull between being desired and being free. Don't compromise your worth to keep someone's approval.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Mars: Fierce, instinctive drive. Assert your will and your boundaries; beware of destructive anger.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Mars: Bold, instinctive action comes naturally. Go after what you want, and trust your sense of when to push.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Mars: Anger at being controlled runs hot. Channel the fire into changing the situation rather than scorching the people in it.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Jupiter: Your untamed side seeks freedom and excess. Expand your sense of what's permissible, wisely.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Jupiter: Confidence in your own unconventional truth. You can live by it more openly in this period, and others respect it.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Jupiter: Excess, or rebellion against received beliefs. Seek freedom with judgement — not everything forbidden is worth having.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Saturn: Instinct meets the rules. You confront old shame and restrictions; claim mature authority over your own life.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Saturn: Independence finds a disciplined form. You can hold your boundaries with quiet authority and be taken seriously.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Saturn: Repression and guilt weigh on you. Refuse unjust constraints calmly, and question the rules you have absorbed without choosing.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Uranus: Rebellion and the breaking of taboos. Liberation is the theme of this period — aim it at what truly confines you.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Uranus: An exhilarating freedom to be different. Act on it; this is an easy period to step outside convention.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Uranus: Defiance turns erratic. Look for real liberation rather than disruption for its own sake.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Neptune: Fantasies and hidden longings surface. Explore them with honesty; they show what you have been missing.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Neptune: Imaginative, sensual inspiration. Let longing feed creative work rather than restlessness.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Neptune: It is easy to deceive yourself about desire in this period. Be clear about what is real and what is fantasy.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Pluto: Intense encounter with your shadow. Power, sexuality and taboo are stirred; transform rather than repress.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Pluto: Owning your shadow is deeply empowering. What you stop hiding stops controlling you.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Pluto: Power struggles and obsession. Face what you fear in yourself, and you take away its hold.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|North Node: Your path calls for greater authenticity and independence. Growth now means being less acceptable and more yourself.
transits.Lilith|Flow|North Node: Your instincts guide you toward growth. Trust the pull, even where it departs from what is expected of you.
transits.Lilith|Tension|North Node: Your wild side resists your direction — or is trying to redirect it. Listen before you overrule it.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Chiron: Old wounds of shame and rejection are touched. Reclaiming your exiled self heals.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Chiron: Healing around shame and desire. You can accept a part of yourself that you were once made to feel was unacceptable.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Chiron: Painful feelings of being unacceptable may surface. Offer yourself the compassion you would offer anyone else.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Lilith: Your Lilith return, about every nine years: a renewal of your relationship with your instincts, desires and independence.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Lilith: An easy phase for expressing your true nature. Your independence feels natural rather than defiant.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Lilith: A crisis point in owning your power. Ask what you have suppressed, and what it would take to stop.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Ascendant: Your untamed side shows. You appear more magnetic, provocative or uncompromising.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Ascendant: You express your independence naturally and with confidence. Others find it attractive rather than threatening.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Ascendant: Others may react strongly to your independence, or you to theirs. Hold your ground gracefully.
transits.Lilith|Conjunction|Midheaven: Your public role is touched by rebellion or taboo. Be authentic in your vocation; expect scrutiny.
transits.Lilith|Flow|Midheaven: You can bring your true self to your work. Authenticity serves your reputation in this period better than conformity.
transits.Lilith|Tension|Midheaven: Conflict between your reputation and your instincts. Don't sacrifice your integrity.

moverThemes.Moon: the passing mood of the day
moverThemes.Venus: today's pull toward pleasure and connection
moverThemes.Mars: today's push of energy and impatience
moverThemes.Jupiter: a long season of growth and opportunity
moverThemes.Saturn: a long season of tests and consolidation
moverThemes.Uranus: a long season of change and awakening
moverThemes.Neptune: a long season of dissolving and dreaming
moverThemes.Pluto: a long season of deep transformation
moverThemes.Chiron: a season of tender spots and healing
moverThemes.Lilith: a season of raw, unruly instinct

dayTones.Flowing: A cooperative day. The contacts to your chart run mostly with the grain, so effort tends to meet less resistance than usual — a good day to ask, offer, and move things along.
dayTones.Mixed: A day of push and pull. Some contacts ease things along while others add friction, so expect a mix of openings and hold-ups, and choose which battles are worth having.
dayTones.Demanding: A demanding day. The main contacts to your chart are frictional, which can show up as pressure, impatience or obstacles; they also make it a strong day for effort that would otherwise be put off.
dayTones.Focused: A concentrated day. The main contacts are conjunctions, which turn the volume up on particular themes rather than making things easier or harder — notice what keeps asking for attention.
dayTones.Quiet: A quiet day for this chart. No close contacts stand out, which leaves room to follow your own rhythm rather than react to outside pressure.

moonInSign.Aries: The Moon in Aries makes the mood brisk and direct: patience runs short, people want to act first and talk later, and new starts come easily.
moonInSign.Taurus: The Moon in Taurus slows the mood and steadies it: comfort, good food and familiar routines feel more appealing than novelty or rush.
moonInSign.Gemini: The Moon in Gemini makes the mood quick and talkative: curiosity is high, attention flits, and messages, errands and conversations multiply.
moonInSign.Cancer: The Moon in Cancer turns the mood inward and protective: home, family and feeling looked after matter more than usual, and sensitivities run close to the surface.
moonInSign.Leo: The Moon in Leo warms the mood and raises the volume: people want to be seen, appreciated and entertained, and generosity comes easily.
moonInSign.Virgo: The Moon in Virgo makes the mood practical and particular: tidying, fixing and getting the details right are satisfying, though it is easy to fret over small things.
moonInSign.Libra: The Moon in Libra makes the mood sociable and diplomatic: company, courtesy and a pleasant atmosphere count for a lot, and decisions may wait for a second opinion.
moonInSign.Scorpio: The Moon in Scorpio deepens the mood: feelings run strong and private, small slights cut deeper, and there is an appetite for what is real rather than polite.
moonInSign.Sagittarius: The Moon in Sagittarius lifts the mood and widens it: optimism, plain speaking and a restless wish for space or adventure are in the air.
moonInSign.Capricorn: The Moon in Capricorn makes the mood businesslike and reserved: getting things done, keeping commitments and being taken seriously feel more important than comfort.
moonInSign.Aquarius: The Moon in Aquarius makes the mood cool and independent: friends, ideas and causes appeal more than intimacy, and people want room to do things their own way.
moonInSign.Pisces: The Moon in Pisces softens the mood and blurs its edges: imagination, empathy and a wish to drift run high, while focus and firm boundaries run low.

moonInHouse.1: Feelings are close to the surface and show on your face; you react more personally than usual, so give yourself room and do something that makes you feel like yourself.
moonInHouse.2: Your mood is tied to security today — money, possessions and creature comforts. A small practical step toward feeling provided for settles you more than any big gesture.
moonInHouse.3: Your mind is busy and your mood rides on conversations, messages and short trips. A good day to talk things through, catch up, and clear small errands.
moonInHouse.4: You want home, quiet and the people who know you best. Feelings about family or the past may surface; time spent in your own space restores you.
moonInHouse.5: You want some fun, colour and self-expression today. Play, romance, creative work or time with children lifts your spirits more than duty does.
moonInHouse.6: Your mood follows how well your day runs: routines, health and work tasks. Sorting one practical thing out — or looking after your body — brings real satisfaction.
moonInHouse.7: Other people set the emotional weather today. Partners and close companions matter more, and you may need to meet someone halfway — or notice how much you rely on them.
moonInHouse.8: Feelings run deep and private. Matters of trust, intimacy and shared money or obligations come to mind; this is a day for honesty with yourself rather than small talk.
moonInHouse.9: You want room to breathe and something bigger to think about — travel, study, a new idea or a wider view. Routine feels confining; meaning feels nourishing.
moonInHouse.10: Your feelings are tied to your standing, work and responsibilities, and others may notice your mood more than usual. Showing up well in public matters today.
moonInHouse.11: Friends, groups and hopes for the future colour the day. Company that shares your interests — or a conversation about where things are heading — does you good.
moonInHouse.12: You need more rest and solitude than usual, and feelings may be hard to put into words. A quieter day, time alone, or letting something go suits this phase well.

sunInHouse.1: This month the spotlight is on you — your appearance, health, initiative and the impression you make. It is your season to start things on your own terms.
sunInHouse.2: This month's focus turns to money, possessions and what you value. It is a natural time to take stock of resources and of your own sense of worth.
sunInHouse.3: This month's focus is on communication, learning and your immediate surroundings: messages, paperwork, siblings, neighbours and short trips all get busier.
sunInHouse.4: This month's focus turns homeward — family, property, roots and private life. It is a season for laying foundations and looking after what sustains you.
sunInHouse.5: This month's focus is on pleasure, creativity, romance and children. Making room for joy and self-expression is not a distraction now; it is the point.
sunInHouse.6: This month's focus is on work, routines and health. It is a good season to improve daily habits, tidy up loose ends, and be useful.
sunInHouse.7: This month's focus moves onto partnerships — close relationships, collaborators and anyone who acts as your counterpart. Others take centre stage.
sunInHouse.8: This month's focus is on shared resources, intimacy and what lies beneath the surface: debts, taxes, trust and the deeper bonds that change you.
sunInHouse.9: This month's focus widens to travel, study, belief and the bigger picture. A season to explore, learn, and question what you take for granted.
sunInHouse.10: This month the spotlight falls on career, reputation and public goals. Your efforts are more visible than usual — a season to aim high and be seen.
sunInHouse.11: This month's focus is on friendships, networks and future plans. Groups and allies matter, and hopes you have set aside may ask to be revived.
sunInHouse.12: This month's focus turns inward and behind the scenes: rest, reflection, endings and quiet preparation before the next cycle begins at your birthday.

moonPhases.NewMoon: A New Moon is a fresh start in the monthly cycle — a natural moment to set an intention and begin small.
moonPhases.WaxingCrescent: With the Moon waxing as a crescent, the month's new intentions are taking their first steps; keep going rather than starting over.
moonPhases.FirstQuarter: The First Quarter is the month's first test: plans meet reality, and a decision or adjustment is called for.
moonPhases.WaxingGibbous: With the Moon waxing toward full, momentum builds — refine, prepare, and polish what you have been working on.
moonPhases.FullMoon: A Full Moon brings things into the open: feelings peak, results show, and what has been building comes to a head.
moonPhases.WaningGibbous: With the Moon waning after full, the mood favours sharing what you have learned and digesting recent events.
moonPhases.LastQuarter: The Last Quarter is a turning point toward release: clear out, let go of what has not worked, and make room.
moonPhases.WaningCrescent: With the Moon a thin waning crescent, the month's cycle winds down — rest, reflect, and finish rather than begin.

retrogrades.Mercury: Mercury's retrograde favours the re- words: review, revise, reconnect, repair. Double-check details, back up files and allow extra time; old contacts and unfinished business tend to resurface.
retrogrades.Venus: Venus's retrograde turns attention back to relationships, money and what you truly value. Old flames and past choices may resurface; it is better for reassessing than for big purchases or new commitments.
retrogrades.Mars: Mars's retrograde turns energy inward. Progress can feel slower and frustration simmer, so revisit plans, conserve effort and pick up stalled projects rather than forcing new ones.

stations.Retrograde: {planet} appears to stand still today before turning back. Its themes are unusually prominent, and what it governs shifts into a period of review.
stations.Direct: {planet} appears to stand still today before moving forward again. Matters it governs that were stalled or under review begin, slowly, to move.
